title: sieve-native/evaluator: REGEX_CACHE key includes redundant anchors
description: crates/sieve-native/src/evaluator.rs str_matches_regex_pat() — the cache key is the full anchored pattern string '(?i)(?s)\A(?:...)\z', which is constructed freshly on every call. The anchoring prefix is constant; only the core pattern and the casemap flag vary. The cache key could be the tuple (pattern, casemap) with the anchored form stored inside, reducing key construction cost and cache memory.
